firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Charlotte landscaping that starts in the red clay.' 8 words, 2 lines, trade+city+thesis; Price it filled + quieter Call outline; phone in header; proof line with Sample rating + open-now; the soil-horizon strip and probe ARE the hero, tan band peeks below. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold, mobile bar. Minor: at 1440 the CTA pair floats far right, detached from the lede it answers.

distinctiveness.notes: Depth-gauge rail on the left of every frame (1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg), horizon depth tags on lawn/soil/drainage sections and '18 in + bedrock' footer (1440-rm-full.jpg). Signature organises the service story by depth: real work, not decoration. Sibling B (landscaper/B 1440-first.jpg) differs in face, palette and hero family. -0.5: 01-09 numbering on the services list (1440-scroll-75.jpg) is the decorative-numbering tell; price/reviews/area/form bands carry no horizon tag.

type.notes: Bitter/Karla + JetBrains Mono accent, strong scale contrast in 1440-first.jpg, tabular numerals present. -0.5: three tiny tracked mono caps labels in one view (TWO-MINUTE YARD CHECK, WHAT DO YOU SEE?, UNTIL THE NEXT FESCUE SEEDING WINDOW) in 1440-rm-full.jpg check+lawn bands. -0.5: footer hours break '7 am - 5:30 / pm' over two lines in 1440-rm-full.jpg footer; first review card set in Bitter at a bigger size while the other two are Karla (1440-rm-full.jpg reviews) reads as inconsistency, not hierarchy.

layout.notes: Good tone rhythm paper/tan/paper/deep/tan/deep/paper/tan/paper/accent/paper/deep (1440-rm-full.jpg), full-bleed drainage diagram as the break. -0.5: 'heading left, card right' shape used 3x (yard check, Price it yourself, Tell us about the yard) in 1440-rm-full.jpg, plus two mirrored text/illustration splits. -0.5: Price it yourself left column is a short heading floating in ~500px of empty height beside the estimator card; footer right two columns sit half-empty (1440-rm-full.jpg).

photo.notes: No raster photography; every visual is a drawn soil cross-section (hero strip, aeration plug diagram, profile column, pH test card, drainage section) in one palette and one texture language (1440-rm-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg). Judged on merit as drawn treatments: one shoot, sequence plan->work->result. Not 9.5: nothing shows a finished yard, the result end of the sequence.

copy.notes: Trade nouns throughout (core aeration, fescue window, swales, French drain, crape myrtles, Piedmont red clay) in 1440-rm-full.jpg; Sample labels on rating, prices, reviews, license; 'Nothing is sent from this demo' under the form. -0.5: the same service blurbs appear verbatim twice-three times (drainage line in story step, drainage band and services row; soil line in soil band and services row) in 1440-rm-full.jpg.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold, sticky call/price bar. 390-full.jpg: story is stacked, not pinned; area chips wrap to thumb-sized targets; estimator full width. -0.5: drainage diagram shrinks to ~290px wide on 390-full.jpg so the numbered markers and the pipe are unreadable; it was not re-cut for the phone.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word and every diagram; render.json clean; forced-colors and reduced-motion queries in dist/index.html; labelled checkboxes, select and slider. Not 9.5: Sample pills are ~11px mono (1440-rm-full.jpg review cards), the smallest text on the page.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: pinned soil profile, active horizon outlined with a pointer while the matching step shows on the right; 1440-scroll-50.jpg: gauge rail fills in horizon colours as you descend. Motion explains order (layer by layer). Not 9.5: right column at 1440-scroll-25.jpg shows one step with half the frame empty, and the rest of the page relies on the same data-reveal (19 hooks in dist/index.html).

wow.notes: The descending soil profile is tied to the thesis (1440-scroll-25.jpg). But the two tools do not speak the signature: the yard check result is a plain text line (1440-rm-full.jpg check card) instead of pointing to a horizon, and the estimator output is a green bar + house icon (1440-rm-full.jpg Price it yourself), not a depth drawing (-1.0 tool output, +0.5 for the drawn bar).

polish.notes: apple-touch, og:image, HomeAndConstructionBusiness JSON-LD, print and forced-colors rules in dist/index.html. -0.5: drop shadows on non-floating cards (yard check, estimator, form, review cards) in 1440-rm-full.jpg; footer hours wrap 5:30 / pm (1440-rm-full.jpg).

elevate.move: Make the mono strictly the depth instrument: keep JetBrains Mono only for inch tags, the gauge and figures, and replace every tracked-caps eyebrow with a Bitter lead-in or nothing, so text-only screenshots read as a field log of depths.

Give the lower page the horizon treatment the upper page has: set Price it yourself, reviews, area and form as further strata (each opened by a full-width wavy horizon edge with its depth tag), and break the three 'heading left, card right' bands into one stacked tool-under-headline and one full-width form strip.
